description: A fixed sequence of calls where each works on the previous output, with gates between steps.
A mechanical check between chain steps (finish reason, format, content rule) that stops the chain before a bad output flows on.
Classify the input into a closed set of routes, then send it to a specialized prompt or model; unusable classifications go to a fallback.
Parallel calls for different, independent subtasks of one input, aggregated in code.
The same request sent several times in parallel; answers are aggregated by majority or by an any-flag rule. Self-consistency is the research form.
A voter whose answer is unusable or whose call failed; it is counted apart instead of failing the vote.
A writer call and an evaluator call in a bounded loop: the evaluator returns pass and feedback, the writer revises.
An orchestrator model decides subtasks at runtime and delegates them to workers; covered with multi-agent systems.
